reason: Both propose the same physically plausible Mo-to-Nb substitution, but B is more specific and testable: it defines substitution levels, predicts a 5–10% strength loss and >50% relative ductility gain, and includes microstructural/dislocation observations with explicit falsification thresholds. Its mechanistic support remains partly extrapolative, but it more clearly establishes a decisive strength–plasticity criterion than A.
